Core Chemical Groups.description: List all key chemical functional groups (–NH₂, –CHO, –COOH, –OH, –C=C–/–C≡C–, –SH, –Br/I/Cl) mentioned in the text, and describe their presence, role, or purpose in the framework.

Terminal Group (or Capping Group).description: Name and type of terminal or capping groups.

Metal Coordination Sites.description: Describe coordinated metal species, linkage type, and coordination geometry or coordination site.

Specialized/Linker Functional Groups.description: Functional groups such as ether, imidazole, sulfonic acid (–SO₃⁻), or quaternary ammonium (–NH₄⁺) present in linkers or specialized motifs.

Adsorption Sites.description: Identify Lewis or Brønsted acid–base sites, hydrogen-bonding sites, or π-binding sites relevant to adsorption.

Organic transformations.description: Catalytic organic transformations and associated performance metrics.

Gas adsorption/separation.description: Target gases, adsorption capacities, separation performance, or selectivity.

Photocatalysis.description: Photocatalytic activity or reaction rates for H₂ evolution, CO₂ reduction, N₂ fixation, water splitting, or organic conversions.

Electrocatalysis.description: Electrocatalytic activity or reaction rates for reactions such as H₂ evolution, CO₂ reduction, N₂ fixation, or water splitting.

Asymmetric Catalysis.description: Asymmetric catalytic performance, including enantioselectivity (e.g., %ee) and/or yield.

Scintillation.description: Use in scintillation applications such as bioimaging or radiation detection.

Photoluminescence (Function).description: Photoluminescence-related functions, such as sensing, imaging, or signal transduction.

Apparent Quantum Yield (AQY).description: Reported apparent quantum yield values and corresponding test wavelength or experimental conditions.
